Call willing allies within 4 squares to make free Basic Melee attacks. They gain 1 Boon against Frightened targets.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Every willing ally within 4 squares who hears you.
Equipment / acquisition
Each attacking ally uses a melee weapon.
Type
Skill / Attack / Support

Each ally makes one free Basic Melee attack against an adjacent enemy. Against a Frightened target, the attack gains 1 Boon.
